name: Ofuro no Mama wa Chou Eroi
original_name: お風呂のママは超エロい
source:
My name is Sakisaka Ryou, a first-year student. Club activities just ended, and I'm walking home bathed in the sunset light. Just about 5 minutes from home, my heart suddenly started pounding. Huh? Why would I be nervous just going back to my own house?

While I was still wondering how to explain it, I reached the front door. Unable to calm my racing heart, I went straight inside and headed right for a specific place. The destination was the changing room, and beyond that was the bath. To wash off the dirt from club activities? Yeah, obviously that's part of it, but it's not just that... I took a deep breath in front of the changing room door and slowly opened it.

"Welcome home, Ryou-kun~~~"
A gentle voice greeted me. Mom, covered only by a towel in front, was waiting for me at the entrance to the bath.
"You finally came home~. Mommy's been waiting so long~"
"I'm home, mom... sorry, practice ran late again today..."
"Mmm, it's okay. Mommy's happy that Ryou-kun works so hard. But you got all dirty practicing hard again today, right? I'll get you all clean, so come get in the bath with mommy quickly~♪"
"Yeah... (blushing)"
And so, tonight's secret bath time with mom begins again.

[Translated from the [url=https://www.studio-pls7.com/pls7/p7-game02.html]official site[/url]]
